entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Compiler Crash with extension blocks #81443
  • [API Proposal]: Obsolete `SourceProductionContext.ReportDiagnostic` #81437

Closed

  • Improve remove and sort using directives #44052
    Backlog
  • Unexpected behavior for lock on `object` type with `yield return` in iterator or async-iterator #81430
  • Parameter names in target-typed new() expressions are missing among completions in compound assignment statements #73894
    Backlog
  • Extension types cannot invoke static generic members. #81439
  • Improve diagnostic when using equality operators for relational patterns #58010
    Backlog
  • "Introduce parameter" may generate duplicate/ambiguous parameters #81400
    Backlog
  • VS 2026 Insiders not processing .editorconfig rules properly #81260
  • Hiccup causes "Computing Rename Information" tooltip to be stuck #80679
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `roslyn/features/collection-expression-arguments` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #81440
  • .Net SDK 8.0.415 on ARM64 Mac - sporadic `Process terminated. System.MissingMethodException: Method not found: 'Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.RefKind Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Symbols.RefKindExtensions.GetRefKind(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.SyntaxKind)'` #81418
  • Reduce cascading errors when record inherits from non-record #63270
    Backlog
  • [EE] [C#14] Unable to evaluate extension members (InvalidCastException) #81429
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11224.11 #81435
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11224.25 #81434

PullRequests

Created

  • Track runtime-async-streams feature as part of runtime-async work #81447
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix null refs of freshly constructed syntax trivia #81444
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Implement exhaustiveness check for Union types #81442
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Closed Class Hierarchies, Feature - Unions
  • Unsafe evolution: add `MemorySafetyRules` attribute #81441
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Parse analysis level with invariant culture #81438
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • AI Rename UI: fix highlighted item on focus #81445
    Area-IDE, Community, Needs UX Triage, Next
  • Document Outline - Add selection indicator at left edge of items #81446
    Area-IDE, Needs UX Triage, Next
  • Improve compiler error recovery for null coalesce assignment operator #80907
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Improve diagnostic for != operator in patterns #81294
    Area-Compilers, Concept-Diagnostic Clarity, VSCode, Next
  • Fix duplicate parameter names in introduce parameter refactoring #81404
    VSCode, Next
  • Report ERR_PatternWrongType for Union matching scenarios #81352
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Merge 'main' into 'features/collection-expression-arguments' #81426
    Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Reduce cascading errors when record inherits from non-record #81293
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Next
  • PublicApi txt file changes after resetting public api files for 18.0 #81433
    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review, Next
  • Fix some minor UI errors that were caused by binding failures #81407
    Area-IDE, Community, Needs UX Triage, Next

Updated

  • Improve error message for misplaced variable designator in property patterns #81287
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix CS1003 error message when expression follows identifier without '=' #81285
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Adjust behavior of is-type operator for `Union` types #81448
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Avoid `virtual` implementations for `AddSynthesizedAttributes` #81289
    Area-Compilers
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81427
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Emit async-iterators with runtime-async when possible #81314
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Add manual merges to feature branch #81428
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Unsafe evolution: handle the rest of pointer-related operations #81420
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Register encoding provider when `GetEncoding` throws `NotSupportedException` #81382
    Area-Compilers
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81409
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
